experiment: V69-T1 representation/generalization campaign: scale + exact symmetry augmentation vs the shallow baseline
precision: CUDA backend: f32 storage/accumulation, matmul inputs possibly TF32; NOT strict FP32. Baselines are host-side f64.

partitions.train: 2000 per family x budget x class cell (24000), nested subsets rank<k for k in {250,1000,2000}
partitions.test: 256 per cell (3072), sealed until final evaluation

data.exclusion: identity-level (full 65-byte canonical keys) against gen-001 AND the G1 pool: a root is removed iff its root key or any child key occurs in the prior index; groups then formed; partitions assigned per connected group (size>50 -> train, else keyed hash 80/10/10)

training.schedule: linear warmup 200 updates to peak lr, cosine decay to 0.1*peak at the final update (update index u: u<200: peak*(u+1)/200; else 0.1*peak+0.45*peak*(1+cos(pi*(u-200)/(U-1-200))))

augmentation.d8: per-sample random element of the 8-element board symmetry group applied to the attacker-relative piece grid (label-preserving; colour relabelling already quotiented by the encoding); stream t1_aug

selection: per model family (A, M): lowest FINAL-update validation BCE among completed runs (ties: higher validation balanced accuracy); validation only; test untouched

final.controls: derangement and erasure as in G1; neural candidates also report 8-fold symmetry test-time-augmentation logits (report-only variant, same invocation)
